kp-update 2026-10-02: py3d 1.9.0 _check_component_naming. Up to 1.8.0 it ran on the Geometry LOD alone and raised ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING on a lowercase component01 ('Engine requires Component01 (uppercase C); collision silently fails'). In-game A/B (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, 2026-10-02, dayz-mcp run 454c93d7; dayz-p3d-audit killer #2, CLAIM-P3D-COMPONENT-CASE-INGAME): component01 collided exactly like Component01 (scene_raycast geom/view/fire 6 of 6 per mode, RayCastBullet, a walking player stopped 0.36 m before the face), unbinarized and binarized, and binarize writes both as component01; a box with no component in its Geometry, View and Fire LODs took 0 rays, missed the physics ray, let the player through, and no log line said so. Owner's choices the same day: the case is not checked (WARN_COMPONENT_NAMING only when no component-like name is Component plus a number, e.g. only Component_01, never measured); the missing-component ERROR runs on Geometry, View and Fire, each LOD on its own (a single LOD missing it was not measured); faces in proxy selections do not count, so a faceless or proxy-only LOD raises nothing; version 1.9.0 in source, no new wheel (the pinned and installed py3d_dayz-1.8.0 keeps the old check; apply-s2-rollout.ps1 -WheelOnly refuses a restock until a 1.9.0 wheel is pinned); WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE left for a separate task. Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, round 1 SOUND-WITH-FIXES (six P2, no P1), fixed: the component name is matched with fullmatch, so 'Component01' plus a trailing newline gets the spelling WARN; only a proxy-shaped selection (a 'proxy:<path>.<index>' name holding exactly 1 triangle and, as its 3 points, that triangle's corners) exempts its face, so a cube under a proxy name is collision geometry (on the corpus below the library's strict proxy anatomy rejects 229 real proxy triangles, the shape rule rejects only 18 proxy-named 8-point selections in LFPowerGrid logic gates, whose LODs all carry components); the message and the README say that the measured case is no component in any collision LOD and that one LOD missing it alone was not measured; the skill text states ERROR for no component-like name and WARN for irregular names only; the knowledge note on Object Builder's case-sensitivity is qualified as unmeasured. Round 2 (gpt-6.1-sol on 565f4cb): SOUND-WITH-FIXES, F1, F2, F4, F5 and F6 fixed, F3 partial (R2-1, P2: a proxy-named selection of 3 points that are not its triangle's corners kept the exemption); fixed after the two-round cap and checked mechanically: the 3 selected points must be the triangle's 3 distinct corners, and on the corpus that rule accepts the same 877 proxy triangles as the shape rule (431 Fire, 433 View, 13 Geometry) and changes no finding. Offline: py3d suite 304 passed, 11 skipped before merging main's #40 (baseline 283 passed, 11 skipped) and 309 passed, 11 skipped after it (#40 adds 5); test_s2_validate12.py (61 tests) fails 19 against the base commit's __init__.py, 8 against the round-1 head and 3 (the corner cases) against the round-2 head, and passes 61 of 61 on the new one; five mutants (no exemption for Fire, WARN when any name is irregular, match() with '$', proxy exemption by name only, proxy corners not checked) are each killed by the test meant for it; dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH. Read-only impact run (verify_impact.py) on 414 unique MLODs of the owner's mod and vehicle projects and the Pack's door samples, through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the base module and the new one: old 94 ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING, all on Geometry LODs (88 with lowercase component names, 5 on Geometry LODs without faces, among them debinarized vanilla sedanwheel_destroyed, 1 with faces and no component); new 1 (that last one); 93 models change verdict, all from that error to none; no finding appears only after the change (every View and Fire LOD with faces carries a component). tools/py3d/KNOWN-ISSUES.md is registered by output_hash only, as #29 and #30 did: its entry carries two adopt inputs and a new merge input would trip SOURCE-CONFLICT-UNDECIDED. kp-update 2026-10-02 promotion unblock. Schema 1 binds a promotion receipt to the checkout that applied it; the nine receipts in promotions/receipts were sealed from a temporary worktree that no longer exists, so promote --check failed with PROMOTION-RECEIPT-JOURNAL-MISMATCH on all nine and the pre-apply journal sweep with PROMOTION-RECOVERY-REQUIRED (diagnosis by Codex on 2026-10-01; re-read in packctl/promotion.py). packctl now reads such a receipt from any checkout whose HEAD tracks it at promotions/receipts/<transaction_id>.json with the same bytes, still matched against the sealed plan and the COMMIT receipt hash; the sweep uses the same rule when the sealed path is gone. A relocated receipt explains targets in a check only when every target its sealed plan wrote lies under the root this installation configures for the same logical target, so a repository sharing the backup root cannot borrow it; the sealed path must be gone, no link may sit on the way, and the file must equal the raw blob at HEAD. Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, round 1 on cf209a5: UNSOUND (P1: receipts copied into another repository's HEAD explained its targets; P2: check and sweep picked different copies; P2: filtered hashes; P3: tests that let mutants survive), all acted upon. Round 2 on 350f6c0: UNSOUND (P1: a configured root moved to its parent still contained the sealed paths, so a receipt explained a concrete path it never wrote; P2: an unreadable sealed path counted as gone; P3: no filter regression), fixed after the last round: a relocated receipt explains a (artifact, target) pair only when the concrete path it wrote is the one this check writes, the sealed path must be absent by os.lstat, and a real clean/smudge filter test pins the raw-byte comparison. kp-update 2026-10-18: pipeline inbox cdc5 (fb-20261018-012600-cdc5), from the Codex (Sol) review of pack #119. _is_junction returned Path.is_junction() when the method exists and False otherwise; Path.is_junction is new in Python 3.12 and pyproject.toml declares requires-python >=3.10, so on 3.10 and 3.11 every link check of the promotion (_path_is_link and the direct calls) treated a junction as a directory. On the owner's PC, Windows with Python 3.11.16, tests/packctl gave 7 failures in the link and junction tests on 37d7cea, which pass with Python 3.14.3. Without the method, _is_junction now compares os.lstat(path).st_reparse_tag with stat.IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT on Windows, as ntpath.isjunction does, and answers False on other systems and when the path cannot be read. With Path.is_junction present, nothing changes. Codex (Sol) review of pack #120, J1: _ensure_known_residue and _remove_artifact asked path.exists() and path.is_symlink(); exists() follows a junction, so one whose target is gone read as absent, and is_symlink() does not see a junction, so _remove_artifact handed one to shutil.rmtree, which refuses it (J5). Both now ask _path_is_link first: a residue that is a junction, broken or not, reaches _contains_links and gives PROMOTION-FOREIGN-TARGET, and artifact removal unlinks a junction. Round 3 of that review, J3 and J4: _rollback_to_pre asked stage.exists() or stage.is_symlink(), so a broken junction at a stage read as absent, and it removed a stage that held a link, even one the apply had made; the residue check of apply_promotion before it creates a stage asked the same. Both now ask _path_is_link, and _rollback_to_pre refuses a stage that is or holds a link with PROMOTION-FOREIGN-TARGET, with the evidence {alias}:{stage name}, and leaves it; the transaction then has no ABORT. Planned by Claude (Anthropic) and applied by Grok CLI.

Rule, with the three details the owner chose: every git-tracked file with no NUL byte in its first 8000 bytes (git's binary test; measured with git 2.53.0, a NUL at byte index 7999 makes git diff call a file binary and one at index 8000 does not) is read as bytes and split on line feeds, one trailing CR dropped, fenced blocks included; a marker line is 7 of '<', '>', '=' or '|' from column 0 followed by a space, a tab or the line end; '<<<<<<<' and '>>>>>>>' lines always count, '=======' and '|||||||' lines only between a '<<<<<<<' line and the next '>>>>>>>' line, so a 7-letter setext heading underline passes. Measured with the final code: on 3e22429 it reads 923 of 932 tracked files (9 binary test fixtures skipped) and reports exactly CHANGELOG.md:143, :153 and :163; the 33-'=' rulers at skills/dayz-pbo-build/SKILL.md:337 and :339, which a 'starts with =======' rule would flag, pass; on this branch it reports 0. A path is read once: mid-merge, git ls-files lists an unmerged path once per index stage (measured, git 2.53.0), which reported every marker three times. tests/packctl/test_validation.py adds nine tests (diff3 hunk line by line with evidence, fences and non-Markdown files with tab and CRLF markers, separators only inside a hunk, lookalikes, untracked and binary files at git's 8000-byte boundary, bytes and git line numbering with a Latin-1 file, markers on a last line without a line feed, an unmerged path from a real git merge reported once, validate_repo wiring); twelve mutations of the check (separators counted anywhere, no tab, no CR strip, splitlines numbering, UTF-8-only reading, no binary skip, a hunk that never closes, a prefix-only pattern, the check unregistered, a 7999-byte sniff, no path dedupe, the last line dropped) each turn at least one of them red. Cross-family review: round 1 SOUND with one optional finding (the last-line test), applied; round 2, the last one, SOUND with two optional findings on the unmerged-path test, applied after it and checked mechanically: the merge passes -c merge.ff=false and the second branch is named after the current one, so the test passes with a global git config holding merge.ff=only and init.defaultBranch=side (before the change it failed there, exit 128 on checkout -b side), and it asserts the three index stages before reading the findings. kp-update 2026-10-03 (pipeline feedback fb-20261002-165907-7e70, fb-20260927-163351-3c81, fb-20260927-164039-386a). (1) dayz-animation-pipeline scripts/seanim_writer.py dropped SEAnim bone modifiers: read_seanim read the modifier block and discarded it (line 164 at ea7b396) and write_seanim always wrote bone_modifier_count = 0 (line 87). Measured 2026-10-03: the DayZATool 1.3 extract of vanilla p_1hd_erc_idle_low.anm (sha256 b798f6d2e2b6141a..., 370,800 B; 65 bones, ABSOLUTE header, 60 RELATIVE modifiers) read and written back by the ea7b396 script came out 370,680 B with the header modifier count 0. read_seanim now returns each bone's modifier (None when it has none) and raises ValueError on a modifier index out of range or repeated; write_seanim writes one (bone index, type) entry per bone carrying a modifier, in bone order, with the index as wide as the reader expects (one byte up to 255 bones, two up to 65,535), and raises ValueError on a value outside 0..255, a bool or a float, or more than 255 modifiers. The fixed script writes that extract and the four clips spliced from it on 2026-10-02 back byte for byte; bones without a modifier key write the same bytes as before. New tests/test_seanim_writer.py: fixtures built byte by byte from the SEAnim v1 layout (SE2Dev io_anim_seanim seanim.py), not with write_seanim, and read the same way by the Pack's tools/dayz-animation-formats strict reader; 22 cases, all 22 failing against the ea7b396 script and passing with the fix (13 written first; 7 added after review round 1, which found 7 kinds of mutant surviving the 13: modifier 0 dropped on read or on write, the bone-index width off by one at 255 or 65,535 bones, only 0..3 accepted, 255 modifiers refused, False accepted; 2 added after review round 2, which found two more surviving the 20: a repeated index accepted when its type repeats too, and a modifier equal to the header's type dropped on write; 13 mutants of those kinds plus two the 13 already caught each fail at least one of the 22). The --self-test also writes and reads one modifier. (2) skeletal-anm-enfusion.md, claim CLAIM-ANIM-DAYZATOOL-NO-MODIFIERS: DayZATool's --generate-anim does not keep the modifiers; that extract regenerated unchanged re-extracts with none, measured 2026-10-03 (hashes and tolerances in the claim; positions within 0.0016 cm on any axis, 0.0027 cm as a distance, after round 1 found the earlier 'within 0.0015 cm' was a rounding of 0.00155). weapon-anim-authoring-viewer.md line 266 and the comment at seanim_export.py lines 205-208 said read_seanim drops the modifiers; they now say it returns them and that seanim_export writes none (seanim_export's output is unchanged). (3) player-skeleton.md, claim CLAIM-ANIM-IKPOSE-OBJECT-FRAME: the frame an ikpose keys LeftHandIKTarget in (the object's, RightHand_Dummy's), RightHandOrigin's unknown frame, LeftHandOrigin's untested one, and the SEAnim axes of a held object (SEAnim Z up, Y depth, signs not fixed), re-measured offline on five vanilla ikposes and two vanilla LOD0s; the in-game observations are the CocaLab session's of 2026-09-27. (4) item-ik-and-hide.md, claim CLAIM-ANIM-ITEM-TURN-MODEL: turn the model about its vertical, not the ikpose, when a vanilla ikpose gives a natural pose and only the item's direction is wrong; confirmed in game by the user on CocaLab commit 0569fea (2026-09-27). kp-update 2026-10-03 (pipeline feedback fb-20261002-165907-7e70, fb-20260927-163351-3c81, fb-20260927-164039-386a). (1) dayz-animation-pipeline scripts/seanim_writer.py dropped SEAnim bone modifiers: read_seanim read the modifier block and discarded it (line 164 at ea7b396) and write_seanim always wrote bone_modifier_count = 0 (line 87). Measured 2026-10-03: the DayZATool 1.3 extract of vanilla p_1hd_erc_idle_low.anm (sha256 b798f6d2e2b6141a..., 370,800 B; 65 bones, ABSOLUTE header, 60 RELATIVE modifiers) read and written back by the ea7b396 script came out 370,680 B with the header modifier count 0. read_seanim now returns each bone's modifier (None when it has none) and raises ValueError on a modifier index out of range or repeated; write_seanim writes one (bone index, type) entry per bone carrying a modifier, in bone order, with the index as wide as the reader expects (one byte up to 255 bones, two up to 65,535), and raises ValueError on a value outside 0..255, a bool or a float, or more than 255 modifiers. The fixed script writes that extract and the four clips spliced from it on 2026-10-02 back byte for byte; bones without a modifier key write the same bytes as before. New tests/test_seanim_writer.py: fixtures built byte by byte from the SEAnim v1 layout (SE2Dev io_anim_seanim seanim.py), not with write_seanim, and read the same way by the Pack's tools/dayz-animation-formats strict reader; 22 cases, all 22 failing against the ea7b396 script and passing with the fix (13 written first; 7 added after review round 1, which found 7 kinds of mutant surviving the 13: modifier 0 dropped on read or on write, the bone-index width off by one at 255 or 65,535 bones, only 0..3 accepted, 255 modifiers refused, False accepted; 2 added after review round 2, which found two more surviving the 20: a repeated index accepted when its type repeats too, and a modifier equal to the header's type dropped on write; 13 mutants of those kinds plus two the 13 already caught each fail at least one of the 22). The --self-test also writes and reads one modifier. (2) skeletal-anm-enfusion.md, claim CLAIM-ANIM-DAYZATOOL-NO-MODIFIERS: DayZATool's --generate-anim does not keep the modifiers; that extract regenerated unchanged re-extracts with none, measured 2026-10-03 (hashes and tolerances in the claim; positions within 0.0016 cm on any axis, 0.0027 cm as a distance, after round 1 found the earlier 'within 0.0015 cm' was a rounding of 0.00155). weapon-anim-authoring-viewer.md line 266 and the comment at seanim_export.py lines 205-208 said read_seanim drops the modifiers; they now say it returns them and that seanim_export writes none (seanim_export's output is unchanged). (3) player-skeleton.md, claim CLAIM-ANIM-IKPOSE-OBJECT-FRAME: the frame an ikpose keys LeftHandIKTarget in (the object's, RightHand_Dummy's), RightHandOrigin's unknown frame, LeftHandOrigin's untested one, and the SEAnim axes of a held object (SEAnim Z up, Y depth, signs not fixed), re-measured offline on five vanilla ikposes and two vanilla LOD0s; the in-game observations are the CocaLab session's of 2026-09-27. (4) item-ik-and-hide.md, claim CLAIM-ANIM-ITEM-TURN-MODEL: turn the model about its vertical, not the ikpose, when a vanilla ikpose gives a natural pose and only the item's direction is wrong; confirmed in game by the user on CocaLab commit 0569fea (2026-09-27). SKILL.md: the routing rows of item-ik-and-hide.md and player-skeleton.md name the two additions. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entries under Added and Fixed. Cross-family review (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, max effort, cap of two rounds): round 1 on 50badc8 UNSOUND on one P1 with repro (the rounded position bound) and two P2 (the 7 surviving mutant kinds; the pot's LOD0 height 24.3 for 24.2 cm); all fixed, and the same rounding pattern corrected in player-skeleton.md ('within 2.2 cm' for 2.22 now 'within 2.3 cm'; wrist positions given as measured, +29.4/-28.0 and +14.2/-15.7 cm). Round 2 on a342190 SOUND-WITH-FIXES, no P1: R1-01, R1-02 and R1-03 closed; R2-01 (P2, the two surviving mutants above) fixed with two cases, R2-02 (P3, the CHANGELOG range '0.48 to 7.31 cm' did not contain the cauldron's 0.478) now '0.47 to 7.31 cm'; both after the cap of two rounds, checked by running the mutants, no third round. Not done: the byte-identical copy of seanim_writer.py in the owner's WeaponAnimPipeline_dev/tools (outside the Pack); per-bone flags are still written as 0, float64 (SEANIM_PRECISION_HIGH) files are still not read by this script (the strict tool reads them), frame_count is still derived from the last key (a file declaring frames past its last key comes back shorter) and the file is still written in place, not atomically (all inherited, the last two found by the reviewer); points 4 and 5 of fb-20260927-163351-3c81 (the ODOL visual bounding box including memory points, and the test-subclass method) are not added beyond a cross-reference. Written by Claude (Anthropic).

kp-update 2026-10-04: port of one section that the orchestration session wrote into the INSTALLED dayz-mcp-verify in place (both skill roots), after the last line of the section port-commit 09adb27 brought in. The section, 'A server HANG is bounded by log tails first: read script.log's tail, and attribute to a REGION, not to the branch you hypothesize', was written 2026-10-04 afternoon after a seed-and-prune strike scenario (LFPowerGrid PR #58, run d5eb2c5d) hung the DayZDiag server between init and the first prune snapshot: obs_1_load_1.json recorded the seed exactly as pre-registered (vanilla_count 3, strike_values [1,2,3]), then one driver snapshot in 16 minutes, RPT frozen, process spinning at ~17-27% CPU, forced kill. As written in the installed copy, the section said: the RPT tail is usually useless for a hang (ends in world-streaming warnings) while the script*.log tail carries the mod MARK and stage lines, so one zero-cost read bounds the spin to the region between the last printed stage and the first missing one (measured: script.log frozen right after '[LFPG_Balance_Native] Orphan sweep pass executed' with zero [VanillaPrune] lines); verify the region's loop structure in source before suspecting it (the prune loop at NetworkManagerImpl :3443-3517 is a descending while whose every branch decrements the index, resolution is per-tick capped, and the endpoint resolver is loop-free, which eliminates the cheap suspects); and attribute a hang to a revision only when the path has run under both revisions (this strike path never ran in-engine under any revision before that day), closing it with a single-variable A/B or a within-revision scenario bisect that toggles one sub-path (delete threshold vs marking only), merge on hold meanwhile. Corrected before landing, after round 1 of the PR #105 review (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, cap of two rounds set before round 1; round 1 UNSOUND): R1-01 (P1) the text no longer says that a path that never ran 'cannot' hang because of the newest change; the attribution stays unproven, a scenario bisect within one revision yields a candidate sub-path, and only a controlled comparison between revisions (same scenario, one variable: the revision, or only the newest change reverted) is evidence of a regression, with the merge on HOLD until it closes; R1-02 (P2) the RPT observation is scoped to this run, and both log tails of a run are read, the one carrying the markers first; R1-03 (P2) the interval between the last printed stage and the first missing one is a candidate until the source and the run's logs confirm the markers' order and obligation, that they belong to the same flow and to this run (a marker printed from a deferred CallLater callback, as in the skill's file-based driver pattern, is not in the init flow), and that their emission is visible; otherwise the stages' entries and exits are instrumented, and a missing stage proves only a lack of observed progress. 'veredicto' became 'verdict', and the Source line records the correction. kp-update 2026-10-03, pipeline inbox tickets fb-20261002-194308-f6f0 (SecretRock) and fb-20260927-213707-4a4b (CocaLab); neither finding was in any skill (git grep on main ea7b396). (1) dayz-physics-engine truth #11 gains a sub-bullet: a Roadway face of another model across a lift's travel stops the ride down. In game (DayZDiag 1.29.163709), SecretRock's elevator cabin (LF_RocaHeli_Cabin, a HouseNoDestruct moved with SetPosition from the update queue, truth #11's mechanism) carried the player up but left them at 18.59 and 12.78 going down (prueba 3, 2026-10-02; trace_cabin_down_from_hangar.jsonl: floor LF_RocaHeli_Interior, linked empty, falling 0, y 12.78). The interior's collision slabs had the shaft hole and its Roadway polygons did not (rh_gen_blender.prueba3.py:1315-1317 vs :1396, :1398; 26 + 16 triangles counted by the project with py3d, not recounted here). With the shaft hole in the Roadway (only the interior model changed) the player rode 2 -> 1 -> 0 linked (prueba 4, 2026-10-03), and a 2 -> 0 ride on build R7.3 stayed linked in all 1033 samples (prueba 5). RaycastRV cannot target Roadway: ObjIntersect is Fire, View, Geom, IFire, None (scripts/3_game/constants.c:31-38, 1.29). Destination chosen over vehicles, basebuilding and persistence because the rule is about what holds a player on a moving platform, next to truths #10 and #11, which already cover lifts and riders. (2) dayz-persistence, a subsection after Contract 3: build what stored entities rest on inside OnMissionStart. The structure, rebuilt from the mod's sidecar by a CallLater 2 s after OnMissionStart with parts 0.5 s after EEInit, came back after the CE-stored helicopter parked on it, which fell 6.9 m and rolled -54.3 degrees (prueba 3, runB_51edb0e6_server_script.log:25, :28, :41); with the restore and parts created inside OnMissionStart the parts came first and the helicopter stayed (0.010 and 0.014 mm, level within 0.07 degrees) in two orderly restarts (prueba 4 runB_9f838de9 and prueba 5 run2_312bacda). Destination chosen over physics and vehicles because the cause and the fix are the order of two restores, the sidecar's and the game storage's; the vehicle only shows it. It matches enforce-script-reference SP-LFS-3. The alternative of freezing vehicles is not measured and not written as a rule. The ticket's 'static array of the recipe manager' is corrected: CanDo receives RecipeBase.m_IngredientsSorted (recipebase.c:30, :494-497), and the explain probe failed the same way with a local array; its rule 'call super only as the final return, like vanilla' is not written as tested. R21-02 (P3): CocaLab d6c255c also split the final 'return tray && ...' into a null guard, so rule 42 and its CHANGELOG entry say which change mattered was not isolated. R21-03 (P3, hypothesis): the restore rule is scoped to a structure rebuilt from the mod's own sidecar that needs nothing from the game's storage. From the round's premise answer: the persistence text says the builds before and after differed in other ways and that the log order is what ties the fall to the timing; the Roadway text attributes 'only that model, only those Roadway polygons' to the project. In game (DayZDiag 1.29.163709), SecretRock's elevator cabin (LF_RocaHeli_Cabin, a HouseNoDestruct moved with SetPosition from the update queue, truth #11's mechanism) carried the player up but left them at 18.59 and 12.78 going down (prueba 3, 2026-10-02; trace_cabin_down_from_hangar.jsonl: floor LF_RocaHeli_Interior, linked empty, falling 0, y 12.78). The interior's collision slabs had the shaft hole and its Roadway polygons did not (rh_gen_blender.prueba3.py:1315-1317 vs :1396, :1398; 26 + 16 triangles counted by the project with py3d, not recounted here). With the shaft hole in the Roadway (only the interior model changed) the player rode 2 -> 1 -> 0 linked (prueba 4, 2026-10-03), and a 2 -> 0 ride on build R7.3 stayed linked in all 1033 samples (prueba 5). RaycastRV cannot target Roadway: ObjIntersect is Fire, View, Geom, IFire, None (scripts/3_game/constants.c:31-38, 1.29). Destination chosen over vehicles, basebuilding and persistence because the rule is about what holds a player on a moving platform, next to truths #10 and #11, which already cover lifts and riders. (2) dayz-persistence, a subsection after Contract 3: build what stored entities rest on inside OnMissionStart. The structure, rebuilt from the mod's sidecar by a CallLater 2 s after OnMissionStart with parts 0.5 s after EEInit, came back after the CE-stored helicopter parked on it, which fell 6.9 m and rolled -54.3 degrees (prueba 3, runB_51edb0e6_server_script.log:25, :28, :41); with the restore and parts created inside OnMissionStart the parts came first and the helicopter stayed (0.010 and 0.014 mm, level within 0.07 degrees) in two orderly restarts (prueba 4 runB_9f838de9 and prueba 5 run2_312bacda). Destination chosen over physics and vehicles because the cause and the fix are the order of two restores, the sidecar's and the game storage's; the vehicle only shows it. It matches enforce-script-reference SP-LFS-3. The alternative of freezing vehicles is not measured and not written as a rule. (3) enforce-script-reference Override Rules, rule 42, and a pointer in references/vanilla-deep-dive.md next to the base CanDo bullet: a recipe's CanDo copies ingredients[0] and [1] to locals first and does not call super.CanDo. In game (DayZDiag 1.29, 2026-09-27, CocaLab B-003): with super.CanDo called first the server CanDo returned false while each part read true and ActionWorldCraft's continue condition cancelled the craft; a replay probe read the tray in both slots after its super call (script_2026-09-27_15-13-14.log:49-50); the fix (CocaLab d6c255c, locals, no super) crafted six buds (script_2026-09-27_15-18-33.log:88). Vanilla 1.29: 1 of 206 CanDo overrides calls super (craftlongtorch.c:61, as its only statement); RecipeBase.CanDo (recipebase.c:551-561) only rejects attachments. The ticket's 'static array of the recipe manager' is corrected: CanDo receives RecipeBase.m_IngredientsSorted (recipebase.c:30, :494-497), and the explain probe failed the same way with a local array; its rule 'call super only as the final return, like vanilla' is not written as tested. Mechanism not established. Cross-family review round 1 (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, desktop codex.exe 0.160.0, read-only, effort max; cap of two rounds set before round 1) on 2155def: SOUND-CON-FIXES, no P1. R21-01 (P2): the Roadway rule said 'any model', which takes in the cabin's own Roadway (lf_rocaheli_cabin.p3d has a 1-face Roadway LOD, read with py3d) and the project's gate leaves the cabin out (rh_gate1.py: rock, interior and shell only); now 'any other model', with the reason. R21-02 (P3): CocaLab d6c255c also split the final 'return tray && ...' into a null guard, so rule 42 and its CHANGELOG entry say which change mattered was not isolated. R21-03 (P3, hypothesis): the restore rule is scoped to a structure rebuilt from the mod's own sidecar that needs nothing from the game's storage. From the round's premise answer: the persistence text says the builds before and after differed in other ways and that the log order is what ties the fall to the timing; the Roadway text attributes 'only that model, only those Roadway polygons' to the project. Measured on the LFQuad material groups 2026-08-27 and merged as section 2b plus four traps: scripts/sat_gate.py:22 drops triangles under 1e-14 UV area before pairing, so an unwrap that collapses faces passes the gate vacuously - 31.0% and 78.0% collapsed meshes were reported PASS with island count and texel density both improving as the defect grew; the fold guard's 2-sample Monte-Carlo over an 8% threshold cannot clear an exact zero-tolerance gate, and driving it with per-island exact SAT converged 31481 and 5839 residual pairs to 0; sparse tree-cotree seams made MINIMUM_STRETCH collapse 78.3% of triangles with no warning and return an all-NaN layer on another group.

Cited LL-371 (commit 1082b5a) so packctl can promote that orphan lesson into the live skill: any gate that filters part of its input must publish total / evaluated / filtered in the verdict; SAT=0 is not atlas-done if collapsed faces were skipped.

Retracted three claims of the 2026-09-01 subsection after measuring them the same night: SEAM_MODE=matonly as a default collapses 100.0% of triangles (695 islands, median 19 faces, against 0.0% for smart_project at 8515 islands); the LOD0-to-LOD1 UV transfer leaves 4647 overlapping pairs and 167 collapsed faces in its best of three forms, because LOD0's islands have a median of 2 faces while a LOD1 face is 2.5x their area; and the 755 px/m floor was derived from two atlases each covering a subset of the same body, so it sat above everything the mod ships. Corrected the texel-density reference in the same pass: the LFQuad wheel _co decodes at 1024^2 with UV density 0.1307-0.1438, i.e. 134-147 px/m, not the ~292 that figure implied against a 2048 texture the asset does not use. Authored in the pack from the LFQuad session of 2026-09-01/02, measured end to end on LFQuad_body.p3d (two visual LODs of 38831 and 15422 faces, 16 materials, 4 wheel proxies). Records how to re-unwrap a model that already ships: making 'UV-only' a fingerprint over points, topology, material assignment and selections and calibrating it by mutation; the seam trade-off with collapse reported next to island count (material-only seams give 695 islands at a median of 19 faces and collapse 100.0% of triangles, while smart_project gives 8515 at a median of 2 and 0.0%); why a transfer onto a decimated LOD cannot work below a granularity ratio (three strategies measured at 25114% occupancy, 8409 overlapping pairs, and 4647 pairs with 167 collapsed faces); the shared-sheet layout that replaces it (both LODs at 0.00% collapsed, 0 SAT pairs each, 0 cross-LOD pairs, a 75/25 split at 349 and 204 px/m); aligning the high-poly by searching 48 axis permutations re-centred on the bounding box (p50 0.47 mm for the winning frame against 163.71 mm for the identity) and gating on the fraction beyond the ray's reach rather than on deviation; and measuring the baked map inside the island cores, since 99.08% of the short normals sit in the packing gutter whose size tracks island count and not bake quality.

Step 3 now reads each face of the group with Check A first, dot(n_face, average of its corner normals) with n_face the face's vector area (sum of cross(v[j]-v[0], v[j+1]-v[0]) over its fan): reading >= +0.5 -> reverse and negate in the same pass, unless the pipeline recalculates normals; <= -0.5 -> reverse only; in between, or a corner on the other side of the face or within 0.1 of its plane -> inspect; then the fix closes on the whole LOD (Check B with no same-direction edge, every corner normal along its face's vector area by at least 0.1, a failing corner inspected, never negated on that reading alone). kp-update 2026-10-03 (owner's choice: a packctl validate check for git merge-conflict markers). Main 3e22429, the squash of #52, committed '<<<<<<< HEAD' (CHANGELOG.md line 143), '=======' (153) and '>>>>>>> 4de8b5a1a84d6efdf81293d5c83d9cabaafef204' (163) into CHANGELOG.md Unreleased -> Fixed, and python -m packctl validate passed with 0 findings; the squash of #67 (f27691e) removed the three lines. packctl/validation.py gains validate_conflict_markers, registered in validate_repo as the check conflict_markers, finding MERGE-CONFLICT-MARKER (error). Rule, with the three details the owner chose: every git-tracked file with no NUL byte in its first 8000 bytes (git's binary test; measured with git 2.53.0, a NUL at byte index 7999 makes git diff call a file binary and one at index 8000 does not) is read as bytes and split on line feeds, one trailing CR dropped, fenced blocks included; a marker line is 7 of '<', '>', '=' or '|' from column 0 followed by a space, a tab or the line end; '<<<<<<<' and '>>>>>>>' lines always count, '=======' and '|||||||' lines only between a '<<<<<<<' line and the next '>>>>>>>' line, so a 7-letter setext heading underline passes. The third review (4505dd0, which read the hook as any top-level name of EntityAI and accepted any override of it; RED, reviews/pack117-codex-sol-r3.md) built, on 1.30, an override that takes a parameter and registers on another entity, and a tree whose EntityAI names the hook only in a string or a field; both fail now, and a brace in a string before the hook no longer hides it. INPUT-ENCODING-ERROR on 3_game/global/world.c (one cp1252 byte, 0x99, in a block comment at line 127) and ES-EMPTY-IFDEF on 4_world/classes/environment/environment.c:1-3 (DIAG_DEVELOPER, which the dayz-mcp v1.4 release game defined on both peers without a crash; pipeline inbox dada) and 4_world/classes/bunkerbroadcasthandler.c:338-340 (ENABLE_LOGGING, which that game also defined: its script logs list both macros among the defines of every script module; corrected by kp-update-818e-w3) are allowed by name with their reasons; the input.c note cited line 266 for the declaration at 272. vanilla_control.py --update and the check after it on P:\scripts: 15 errors and 424 warnings over 3043 files, digest 43ef5a13, the same in both runs, PASS, and PASS again with the final rule. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests: 255 passed (246 before). Baseline: tree.dayz_build names the measured build (1.30.0.164078); the source map keeps 1.29.0.163451. Planned by Claude (Anthropic) and applied by Grok CLI; Claude wrote the third review round (the vanilla gate) and the baseline notes.

kp-update 2026-10-03: ES-UNDEFINED-CLASS-REF, the tree-level check written on 2026-09-19 in the Pack's main checkout and never committed, ported to main unchanged: tools/dayz-script-validator is identical at bc042c2 and main ea7b396, and every ported file was compared by sha256 with the checkout's copy. The rule flags a class-like name used where only a type fits (Name.Method(, Name.Cast(, new Name, a template argument, a typed declaration at the start of a line) when no class, enum or typedef of that name is declared in the addon, the vanilla tree (--vanilla-root, then DAYZ_VANILLA_ROOT, then P:\scripts) or an --external-scripts root, and lists under info.skipped_checks, never as a finding, what it cannot judge: no vanilla tree, a requiredAddons[] entry outside DZ_* that no scanned root declares in CfgPatches, or no requiredAddons[] entry at all. Evidence: netcopdev/TransferZ PR #12 at 11da911 deletes a 4_World class that 5_Mission still calls (TransferZ_MaintenanceClient.c:59), and the linter answered WARN with 0 errors (CLAIM-ENFORCE-UNDEFINED-TYPE-REF, offline_tested, not booted). script_validator.py wires the rule and --vanilla-root and prints SKIP lines in --terse; vanilla_control.py passes the tree as its own vanilla root, and the resolver moves to scripts/shared/vanilla_tree.py; the README documents the rule; tests/test_script_validator.py adds TestUndefinedClassRef (10 tests) and hides DAYZ_VANILLA_ROOT and P:\scripts from the module, so no verdict depends on what the machine mounts. CHANGELOG.md: an Unreleased Added entry; sources/claims.json: CLAIM-ENFORCE-UNDEFINED-TYPE-REF. Cross-family review round 1 (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-03) reported two P1 false FAILs and four P2 wrong FAIL-versus-SKIP decisions, each with an executable repro, all fixed and each fix guarded by a test that a mutant of it turns red: the second variable of `string a, B;` is now a variable (comma declarators are collected); the #ifndef and #else branches of a macro the scanned code #defines outside any #if block, or that a scanned CfgMods defines[] lists, are not judged (a #define inside a block stays a two-way flag, as vanilla's 1_core/defines.c build flags are); a requiredAddons[] token that is not a string literal is an unknown dependency; the requiredAddons[] of every scanned dependency that the addon requires is followed, so a dependency of a dependency must be scanned too; a vanilla root must be a directory that declares class Managed (1_core/proto/enscript.c:117); and only the 211 CfgPatches names of P:\DZ (1.29.0.163451), the scripts tree and the 1.30.164014 Exp data count as vanilla, listed in scripts/shared/vanilla_patches.py, since four mod patches under P:\ use the DZ_ prefix too. After the fixes: 179 tests passed, and the vanilla control still PASSes with the same 33 003 references judged and no finding. Round 2, the last under the cap of two (on d9cab80), closed all six round-1 findings and reported four more with executable repros, fixed after the cap and checked mechanically, not re-reviewed: commas inside template arguments (`new Param3<int, X, int>(...)`) no longer declare variables; a CfgMods defines[] written under a preprocessor condition is not always on; any requiredAddons[] entry that is not a string literal (a number too) is an unknown dependency; and the vanilla anchor must be a class Managed, not an enum. A test also covers a dependency config that declares two patches. 179 tests pass, each of 14 mutants of the fixes turns at least one red, and the vanilla control still PASSes. Round 3, one extra and final round authorised by the orchestrator for the post-cap fixes only (read-only, on dfeb51a), closed R21-07..R21-10 and reported two new P1 false FAILs with executable repros: `bool a = x<y, B = false;` read `x<y` as a template and lost B, and a defines[] under an #ifdef of a macro the same config #defines first was not counted as always on. Fixed without a fourth review round: a `<` opens template arguments only when names, spaces, commas and nested `<...>` lead to its matching `>`, and a line is kept for certain outside every block or under an #ifdef of a macro the same file #defines before it, for configs and scripts alike, each defines[] entry judged on its own line. 179 tests pass, the round-3 repros now give no finding (and a defines[] entry under an unknown #ifdef still leaves its #ifndef judged), each of 19 mutants of the fixes turns a test red, and the vanilla control still PASSes with 33 003 references judged. Winding section: 'The correct fix for an inverted face is always face.vertices.reverse()' replaced by the disagreement reading and a three-step order (winding of visual LODs, winding of collision LODs, normals corner by corner), as dayz-p3d-audit 'Absolute winding check: what 0 % means' (rules 1, 4, 5) and references/winding-diagnostics.md (Check A; from Check B to fix: groups by shared edge, pool mechanics) establish, with dayz-model-pipeline Rule 12 (in game 2026-10-01, DayZDiag 1.29.163709: cross product and stored normals both inward), Rule 18 (per-component outward check) and Rule 1 (Geometry components convex); LFSecure 2026-09-07, DayZDiag 1.29: reversing every face on a 0 % reading rendered two exports inside-out, negating their normals rendered them right side out; adds that the absolute check cannot see faces and normals turned together (transform(ROT_X_NEG90) alone, variant C, 100 % agreement, validate() returns []), that open sheets and double-sided parts are left out, that copies count toward the 32768-entry budget validate() checks, and that a wrong normal sign renders solid but lit inverted (CLAIM-CHAR-NORMALS-INWARD-INGAME) instead of inside-out; test counts 290/283 (measured with and without PY3D_UPSTREAM_PATH). The fix order the message and README give: settle the winding first with normals untouched (visual LOD: per closed shell, turn the vertex order of the faces that disagree with their neighbours, then reverse the whole shell if its signed volume by winding has the wrong sign; collision LOD: reverse the faces that point outward in each convex component), then negate each corner normal still against its face, re-pointing corners whose entry a kept corner also uses to an existing entry with the negated value or a negated copy. Offline, on the Rule 12 in-game fixture (variant B rebuilt byte for byte, SHA-256 asserted against MEASURED): B with its normals negated and B with its faces reversed both read 0 % and raise the same finding with identical text; per-box signed volume keeps B's negative sign (-0.084, -0.0132, -0.0066, -0.0048) with the normals turned and flips it with the faces turned; the wrong fix silences the finding and leaves cross product and normals outward on 48/48 faces; validate() returns [] on variant C. Cases from the two review rounds, each re-run by the receptor and now a test: a 6-entry shared pool negated in place leaves 75 % with the stem's 12 faces wrong; a plate with one reversed face keeps volume -0.084, so the volume alone leaves that face inside-out; turning a right odd face with its normal leaves 47/48 with validate() == []; negating whole faces on a first-corner reading leaves 48 of 144 corners right with 100 % agreement; the order above gives back B (48/48/48, 144 corners, pool kept at 6) in every case. A synthetic ring-shaped FireGeometry reads 264 of 336 correct faces outward by the centroid test. py3d suite 283 passed, 11 skipped (290 passed, 4 skipped with PY3D_UPSTREAM_PATH at upstream 7acd58b). Negative controls on the 8 new tests: da73457 fails 3, round-1 6a13435 fails 2, round-2 42a9d5b fails 1, and a mutated solid, room or collision sign fails 1 each. Authored by Claude (Anthropic) on the owner's request (2026-10-02: make the py3d ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS hint say what is established). Cross-family review on PR #37 by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, cap of two rounds set before round 1: round 1 UNSOUND (shared pool entries; a shell with one reversed face; concave components; an unqualified docstring; tests blind to an inverted sign), round 2 UNSOUND (turning a right odd face with its normal; whole-face negation on a first-corner reading; the 32768 normal budget; the room sign untested), every finding reproduced by the receptor; the round-2 findings fixed after the cap and verified mechanically.

Offline, 2026-10-02, on the clean multi-LOD model of the py3d tests (build_multilod_v2_p3d after blender_to_dayz(), validate() == []): with the visual LOD's shell turned inside-out, faces and normals together (the absolute check passes it), ERR_WINDING_INVERTED fired on the three healthy collision LODs (geometry, view_geometry, fire_geometry: 0 % of faces wound outward from the LOD centroid, visual 100 %) and nowhere else, and no other finding saw the inside-out visual LOD; with the geometry LOD turned instead, on that LOD only (100 % vs 0 %). The visual shell's signed volume by winding reads negative on the clean model and positive turned (also what a room seen from inside is); the collision boxes read 0 of 6 faces outward clean and 6 of 6 turned. The message's winding steps, run on the visual LOD it names and on the collision LODs, reversed the turned LOD and nothing else (320 shell faces, or 6), and fixing the corners then gave back the clean model exactly (points, normal pools, vertex and normal indices, UVs). An inside-out open surface (the shell less one face: 319 faces, all wound outward) raises the finding on the three collision LODs and the steps change nothing, so the message calls such a part unresolved. Reversing the faces of the three flagged LODs, the old message's fix, traded the finding for ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS on each; negating their normals as well left validate() at [] with every LOD wound outward, the collision boxes 6 of 6 outward as transform(ROT_X_NEG90) alone leaves them, the map whose collision LODs registered no raycast in game (py3d README, Blender -> DayZ). On 12 turned states (the visual LOD or one collision LOD, its faces, its normals or both) the 8 ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS messages are byte-identical to main's and every finding's code, severity and LOD index is unchanged. py3d suite 288 passed, 11 skipped (295 passed, 4 skipped with PY3D_UPSTREAM_PATH at upstream 7acd58b; main: 283 and 290). kp-update 2026-10-02: py3d 1.9.0 _check_component_naming. Up to 1.8.0 it ran on the Geometry LOD alone and raised ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING on a lowercase component01 ('Engine requires Component01 (uppercase C); collision silently fails'). In-game A/B (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, 2026-10-02, dayz-mcp run 454c93d7; dayz-p3d-audit killer #2, CLAIM-P3D-COMPONENT-CASE-INGAME): component01 collided exactly like Component01 (scene_raycast geom/view/fire 6 of 6 per mode, RayCastBullet, a walking player stopped 0.36 m before the face), unbinarized and binarized, and binarize writes both as component01; a box with no component in its Geometry, View and Fire LODs took 0 rays, missed the physics ray, let the player through, and no log line said so. Owner's choices the same day: the case is not checked (WARN_COMPONENT_NAMING only when no component-like name is Component plus a number, e.g. only Component_01, never measured); the missing-component ERROR runs on Geometry, View and Fire, each LOD on its own (a single LOD missing it was not measured); faces in proxy selections do not count, so a faceless or proxy-only LOD raises nothing; version 1.9.0 in source, no new wheel (the pinned and installed py3d_dayz-1.8.0 keeps the old check; apply-s2-rollout.ps1 -WheelOnly refuses a restock until a 1.9.0 wheel is pinned); WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE left for a separate task. Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, round 1 SOUND-WITH-FIXES (six P2, no P1), fixed: the component name is matched with fullmatch, so 'Component01' plus a trailing newline gets the spelling WARN; only a proxy-shaped selection (a 'proxy:<path>.<index>' name holding exactly 1 triangle and, as its 3 points, that triangle's corners) exempts its face, so a cube under a proxy name is collision geometry (on the corpus below the library's strict proxy anatomy rejects 229 real proxy triangles, the shape rule rejects only 18 proxy-named 8-point selections in LFPowerGrid logic gates, whose LODs all carry components); the message and the README say that the measured case is no component in any collision LOD and that one LOD missing it alone was not measured; the skill text states ERROR for no component-like name and WARN for irregular names only; the knowledge note on Object Builder's case-sensitivity is qualified as unmeasured. Round 2 (gpt-6.1-sol on 565f4cb): SOUND-WITH-FIXES, F1, F2, F4, F5 and F6 fixed, F3 partial (R2-1, P2: a proxy-named selection of 3 points that are not its triangle's corners kept the exemption); fixed after the two-round cap and checked mechanically: the 3 selected points must be the triangle's 3 distinct corners, and on the corpus that rule accepts the same 877 proxy triangles as the shape rule (431 Fire, 433 View, 13 Geometry) and changes no finding. Offline: py3d suite 304 passed, 11 skipped before merging main's #40 (baseline 283 passed, 11 skipped) and 309 passed, 11 skipped after it (#40 adds 5); test_s2_validate12.py (61 tests) fails 19 against the base commit's __init__.py, 8 against the round-1 head and 3 (the corner cases) against the round-2 head, and passes 61 of 61 on the new one; five mutants (no exemption for Fire, WARN when any name is irregular, match() with '$', proxy exemption by name only, proxy corners not checked) are each killed by the test meant for it; dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH. Read-only impact run (verify_impact.py) on 414 unique MLODs of the owner's mod and vehicle projects and the Pack's door samples, through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the base module and the new one: old 94 ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING, all on Geometry LODs (88 with lowercase component names, 5 on Geometry LODs without faces, among them debinarized vanilla sedanwheel_destroyed, 1 with faces and no component); new 1 (that last one); 93 models change verdict, all from that error to none; no finding appears only after the change (every View and Fire LOD with faces carries a component). tools/py3d/KNOWN-ISSUES.md is registered by output_hash only, as #29 and #30 did: its entry carries two adopt inputs and a new merge input would trip SOURCE-CONFLICT-UNDECIDED. Skill notes that described the old behaviour (dayz-p3d-audit SKILL.md killer #2 and PART 5 item 5, killers-detail.md section 2 Detection, dayz-vehicles rip-import.md 3.5 and vehicle-structural-parity.md, dayz-clothing autofit-from-official-rig.md) now say which py3d version does what; the README test count follows the merged suite (316 tests, 309 on a plain run). Written by Claude (Anthropic).

kp-update 2026-10-02: py3d 1.9.0 _check_component_coverage (WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE). Up to 1.8.0, and on main after #46, it read the Geometry LOD only when it held a selection named exactly 'Component01' and compared that selection alone with the whole LOD ('Component01 covers %d/%d vertices; uncovered vertices won't participate in collision.' and the same for faces): it fired whenever Component01 held fewer points or faces than the LOD, as on a healthy multi-component LOD, never read a LOD without an exact Component01 (lowercase components included), counted proxy triangles and points that no face uses, and did not run on View or Fire. Owner's choices the same day: coverage is the union of every selection named Component plus a number, in any case (#46's _COMPONENT_NAME_RE, fullmatch), on the Geometry, View and Fire LODs; points that no face uses are ignored; it stays a WARN. Implementation: it counts the faces that are not proxy triangles (#46's _proxy_triangle_faces) that no component holds, and the points those faces use that none holds; a nonzero weight is membership, as in the file; one finding per LOD; a LOD with no component is left to ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING, and one whose component selections are all empty is reported with every face counted; it ships under #46's unreleased 1.9.0 with no new wheel. In-game basis: the killer #2 run (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, CLAIM-P3D-COMPONENT-CASE-INGAME): a box with no component in its Geometry, View and Fire LODs collided with nothing; a face outside every component on a LOD that has others was not measured, so killer #8 now calls that consequence expected, not measured, and quotes the replaced text in dated notes. Offline: py3d suite 334 passed, 11 skipped (base: 309 passed, 11 skipped); the 25 new tests of test_s2_validate12.py run against the base commit's module fail 20 and pass 5 (guards: lowercase components covering the LOD, a LOD with no component, the face-outside mutant whose message test discriminates, and fractional weights, which instead fail on a mutant that counts only weight 1), and all 25 pass on the new one; dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH. Read-only impact run on 414 unique MLODs (the owner's mod and vehicle projects and the Pack's door samples) through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the base module and the new one: old 78 findings on 39 Geometry LODs, new 3 (the door sample Expert_Mode, whose lever is in no component in its Geometry and Fire LODs, and a vehicle Fire LOD with two 1 mm triangles in no selection); no other finding changed in any model. The impact and consumer runs used the module of 7cb410f; the review fixes after it change no executable line (AST compared without docstrings). Cross-family review: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, cap of 2 rounds set before round 1: round 1 SOUND-WITH-FIXES (three P2, fixed), round 2 SOUND (all three resolved, no new finding). Skill notes on this finding (dayz-p3d-audit SKILL.md killer #8, references/killers-detail.md section 8) now say which py3d version does what; the py3d README test count follows the suite. Written by Claude (Anthropic).

kp-update 2026-10-03: py3d 1.10.0 _check_component_coverage. Up to 1.9.0 every Geometry, View or Fire face that no ComponentNN selection holds raised WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE, whose message said that faces outside every component beside covered ones were not measured, but to expect them to take no part in collision. The in-game A/B of #65 (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, 2026-10-02, dayz-mcp run cf2d6bb3; CLAIM-P3D-UNCOVERED-FACES-INGAME) measured that case on whole closed parts: beside box A in Component01, box B in no component of its Geometry, View and Fire LODs took 0 of 46 rays (geom, view, fire, RayCastBullet) and the player walked through it, while as Component02 it took 26 of 26 and stopped the player; the Expert tutorial's closed lever, in no component in Geometry and Fire and a component in View only, took no Geometry, Fire or physics ray and was hit in View only; a part left out only in part was not measured (#65 review round 1, F2). Owner's choices (AskUserQuestion, 2026-10-02): an ERROR only where measured; version 1.10.0, because the 1.9.0 wheel pinned by #60 carries the 1.9.0 check; the change built on #65 and opened after it merged. Implementation: the LOD's faces, proxy triangles aside, are grouped into pieces that share a corner position, read as the MLOD stores it (float32); a piece that is a closed solid (every edge used by two of its faces, once each way, and thicker, twice its volume over its area with the volume summed by math.fsum from the piece's own first corner, than 16 float32 steps at its distance from the origin, at least 1 m) with no face and no point in any component raises ERR_COMPONENT_COVERAGE (ERROR); its message names the measured omissions (all three LODs for the box, Geometry and Fire for the lever) and says that a part left out of one LOD alone, component selections that hold nothing, and weapon fire were not measured. Every other face in no component (a part left out in part, an open piece, a flat double-sided sheet) and the points-only case stay WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE, whose message now says not measured and no longer counts the ERROR's faces. Consumers read before the choice: dayz-model-preflight runner.py turns an ERROR into PREFLIGHT_PY3D_ERROR and a FAIL verdict, dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract audit.py refuses an MLOD with any ERROR other than a deferred ERR_AXIS_SELECTION_MISSING, python -m py3d validate exits 1, and validate() skips its in-memory round trip. Offline: py3d suite 386 passed, 11 skipped (base 334 passed, 11 skipped; the 7 CANON tests were not run, no upstream clone); dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH (round 0 code). Read-only impact on 414 unique MLODs (the owner's projects on the P: drive and the dayz-doors samples) through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the 1.9.0 and 1.10.0 modules: Expert_Mode's Geometry and Fire LODs move from the WARN to the ERROR (the lever, one closed 18-face piece in no component), a vehicle Fire LOD keeps the WARN, with the new message, for two stray 1 mm triangles, and no other finding changed in any model; with the full validate(), making every coverage finding an ERROR would flip one verdict (Expert_Mode, PASS to FAIL) while 160 of the 414 already fail on other ERRORs. Cross-family review (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, read-only, cap of 2 rounds set before round 1): round 1 UNSOUND on 756daa7, F1 P1 (the volume summed from the model's origin cancelled, so a flat double-sided sheet 1.8 mm across near 62.5 m read as a solid and raised the ERROR), F2 P2 (per-kind message projected a three-LOD and a two-LOD omission onto one LOD), F3 P2 (no test for exactly one covered face, either winding, float32 rounding), F4 P2 (README counted the unrun CANON tests); all four fixed as above, with tests. Round 2 SOUND-WITH-FIXES on 32d1178 (F1, F3, F4 resolved, F2 partial): N1 P2 (the WARN called a closed slab under the cutoff not a closed solid; it now says too thin to count as solid at its distance from the origin), N2 P2 (the ERROR message, and the openings of killer #8 in SKILL.md and killers-detail.md section 8, gave the lever the box's walk-through; each part now has its own readings, the old text quoted in dated notes), N3 P2 (a 32-step cutoff and a 3V/A thickness survived; now pinned by a box-size oracle and slabs 10 % under and over the cutoff), N4 P3 (an exactly flat sheet gives 0 or a residue far below the cutoff, not always 0); fixed after the cap and checked mechanically, no third round. On the final code: test_s2_validate12.py (138 tests) fails 36 of them on the 1.9.0 module, 22 on the round-0 head 756daa7 and 6 on the round-1 head 32d1178; all 21 mutants of the check are killed, among them the reviewers' (one covered face, the volume's sign, a 32-step cutoff, a 3V/A thickness) and the volume summed from the model's origin, which only the exact-zero flat-sheet test kills (200,000 float32-exact flat sheets never brought that sum above 0.05 % of the cutoff); the 414-model impact on the final code is as above (two models change, nothing else, no exception). kp-update 2026-10-02: py3d 1.9.0 _check_component_naming. Up to 1.8.0 it ran on the Geometry LOD alone and raised ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING on a lowercase component01 ('Engine requires Component01 (uppercase C); collision silently fails'). In-game A/B (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, 2026-10-02, dayz-mcp run 454c93d7; dayz-p3d-audit killer #2, CLAIM-P3D-COMPONENT-CASE-INGAME): component01 collided exactly like Component01 (scene_raycast geom/view/fire 6 of 6 per mode, RayCastBullet, a walking player stopped 0.36 m before the face), unbinarized and binarized, and binarize writes both as component01; a box with no component in its Geometry, View and Fire LODs took 0 rays, missed the physics ray, let the player through, and no log line said so. Owner's choices the same day: the case is not checked (WARN_COMPONENT_NAMING only when no component-like name is Component plus a number, e.g. only Component_01, never measured); the missing-component ERROR runs on Geometry, View and Fire, each LOD on its own (a single LOD missing it was not measured); faces in proxy selections do not count, so a faceless or proxy-only LOD raises nothing; version 1.9.0 in source, no new wheel (the pinned and installed py3d_dayz-1.8.0 keeps the old check; apply-s2-rollout.ps1 -WheelOnly refuses a restock until a 1.9.0 wheel is pinned); WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE left for a separate task. Cross-family review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, round 1 SOUND-WITH-FIXES (six P2, no P1), fixed: the component name is matched with fullmatch, so 'Component01' plus a trailing newline gets the spelling WARN; only a proxy-shaped selection (a 'proxy:<path>.<index>' name holding exactly 1 triangle and, as its 3 points, that triangle's corners) exempts its face, so a cube under a proxy name is collision geometry (on the corpus below the library's strict proxy anatomy rejects 229 real proxy triangles, the shape rule rejects only 18 proxy-named 8-point selections in LFPowerGrid logic gates, whose LODs all carry components); the message and the README say that the measured case is no component in any collision LOD and that one LOD missing it alone was not measured; the skill text states ERROR for no component-like name and WARN for irregular names only; the knowledge note on Object Builder's case-sensitivity is qualified as unmeasured. Round 2 (gpt-6.1-sol on 565f4cb): SOUND-WITH-FIXES, F1, F2, F4, F5 and F6 fixed, F3 partial (R2-1, P2: a proxy-named selection of 3 points that are not its triangle's corners kept the exemption); fixed after the two-round cap and checked mechanically: the 3 selected points must be the triangle's 3 distinct corners, and on the corpus that rule accepts the same 877 proxy triangles as the shape rule (431 Fire, 433 View, 13 Geometry) and changes no finding. Offline: py3d suite 304 passed, 11 skipped before merging main's #40 (baseline 283 passed, 11 skipped) and 309 passed, 11 skipped after it (#40 adds 5); test_s2_validate12.py (61 tests) fails 19 against the base commit's __init__.py, 8 against the round-1 head and 3 (the corner cases) against the round-2 head, and passes 61 of 61 on the new one; five mutants (no exemption for Fire, WARN when any name is irregular, match() with '$', proxy exemption by name only, proxy corners not checked) are each killed by the test meant for it; dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH. Read-only impact run (verify_impact.py) on 414 unique MLODs of the owner's mod and vehicle projects and the Pack's door samples, through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the base module and the new one: old 94 ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING, all on Geometry LODs (88 with lowercase component names, 5 on Geometry LODs without faces, among them debinarized vanilla sedanwheel_destroyed, 1 with faces and no component); new 1 (that last one); 93 models change verdict, all from that error to none; no finding appears only after the change (every View and Fire LOD with faces carries a component). tools/py3d/KNOWN-ISSUES.md is registered by output_hash only, as #29 and #30 did: its entry carries two adopt inputs and a new merge input would trip SOURCE-CONFLICT-UNDECIDED. kp-update 2026-10-03: py3d 1.10.0 _check_component_coverage. Up to 1.9.0 every Geometry, View or Fire face that no ComponentNN selection holds raised WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE, whose message said that faces outside every component beside covered ones were not measured, but to expect them to take no part in collision. The in-game A/B of #65 (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, 2026-10-02, dayz-mcp run cf2d6bb3; CLAIM-P3D-UNCOVERED-FACES-INGAME) measured that case on whole closed parts: beside box A in Component01, box B in no component of its Geometry, View and Fire LODs took 0 of 46 rays (geom, view, fire, RayCastBullet) and the player walked through it, while as Component02 it took 26 of 26 and stopped the player; the Expert tutorial's closed lever, in no component in Geometry and Fire and a component in View only, took no Geometry, Fire or physics ray and was hit in View only; a part left out only in part was not measured (#65 review round 1, F2). Owner's choices (AskUserQuestion, 2026-10-02): an ERROR only where measured; version 1.10.0, because the 1.9.0 wheel pinned by #60 carries the 1.9.0 check; the change built on #65 and opened after it merged. Implementation: the LOD's faces, proxy triangles aside, are grouped into pieces that share a corner position, read as the MLOD stores it (float32); a piece that is a closed solid (every edge used by two of its faces, once each way, and thicker, twice its volume over its area with the volume summed by math.fsum from the piece's own first corner, than 16 float32 steps at its distance from the origin, at least 1 m) with no face and no point in any component raises ERR_COMPONENT_COVERAGE (ERROR); its message names the measured omissions (all three LODs for the box, Geometry and Fire for the lever) and says that a part left out of one LOD alone, component selections that hold nothing, and weapon fire were not measured. Every other face in no component (a part left out in part, an open piece, a flat double-sided sheet) and the points-only case stay WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE, whose message now says not measured and no longer counts the ERROR's faces. Consumers read before the choice: dayz-model-preflight runner.py turns an ERROR into PREFLIGHT_PY3D_ERROR and a FAIL verdict, dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract audit.py refuses an MLOD with any ERROR other than a deferred ERR_AXIS_SELECTION_MISSING, python -m py3d validate exits 1, and validate() skips its in-memory round trip. Offline: py3d suite 386 passed, 11 skipped (base 334 passed, 11 skipped; the 7 CANON tests were not run, no upstream clone); dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH (round 0 code). Read-only impact on 414 unique MLODs (the owner's projects on the P: drive and the dayz-doors samples) through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the 1.9.0 and 1.10.0 modules: Expert_Mode's Geometry and Fire LODs move from the WARN to the ERROR (the lever, one closed 18-face piece in no component), a vehicle Fire LOD keeps the WARN, with the new message, for two stray 1 mm triangles, and no other finding changed in any model; with the full validate(), making every coverage finding an ERROR would flip one verdict (Expert_Mode, PASS to FAIL) while 160 of the 414 already fail on other ERRORs. Cross-family review (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, read-only, cap of 2 rounds set before round 1): round 1 UNSOUND on 756daa7, F1 P1 (the volume summed from the model's origin cancelled, so a flat double-sided sheet 1.8 mm across near 62.5 m read as a solid and raised the ERROR), F2 P2 (per-kind message projected a three-LOD and a two-LOD omission onto one LOD), F3 P2 (no test for exactly one covered face, either winding, float32 rounding), F4 P2 (README counted the unrun CANON tests); all four fixed as above, with tests. Round 2 SOUND-WITH-FIXES on 32d1178 (F1, F3, F4 resolved, F2 partial): N1 P2 (the WARN called a closed slab under the cutoff not a closed solid; it now says too thin to count as solid at its distance from the origin), N2 P2 (the ERROR message, and the openings of killer #8 in SKILL.md and killers-detail.md section 8, gave the lever the box's walk-through; each part now has its own readings, the old text quoted in dated notes), N3 P2 (a 32-step cutoff and a 3V/A thickness survived; now pinned by a box-size oracle and slabs 10 % under and over the cutoff), N4 P3 (an exactly flat sheet gives 0 or a residue far below the cutoff, not always 0); fixed after the cap and checked mechanically, no third round. On the final code: test_s2_validate12.py (138 tests) fails 36 of them on the 1.9.0 module, 22 on the round-0 head 756daa7 and 6 on the round-1 head 32d1178; all 21 mutants of the check are killed, among them the reviewers' (one covered face, the volume's sign, a 32-step cutoff, a 3V/A thickness) and the volume summed from the model's origin, which only the exact-zero flat-sheet test kills (200,000 float32-exact flat sheets never brought that sum above 0.05 % of the cutoff); the 414-model impact on the final code is as above (two models change, nothing else, no exception). Written by Claude (Anthropic).

kp-update 2026-10-03: follow-up of PR #71's cross-family review, round 2, finding R5-02 (PRE-EXISTING, left out of #71's scope). py3d 1.9.0's ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS and ERR_WINDING_INVERTED messages (tools/py3d/py3d/__init__.py at 4de8b5a: lines 1152-1154 and 1221-1224) and the py3d README 'Winding' step 3 (README.md lines 244-254) closed with 'negate each corner normal that still points against its face'; dayz-p3d-audit references/winding-diagnostics.md, 'From Check B to fix' item 3 (lines 184-197), rules that out: a corner that fails is inspected, never negated on its own reading, since a corner normal smoothed across a sharp fold can point against a face that is right. kp-update 2026-10-03: py3d 1.10.0 _check_component_coverage. Up to 1.9.0 every Geometry, View or Fire face that no ComponentNN selection holds raised WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE, whose message said that faces outside every component beside covered ones were not measured, but to expect them to take no part in collision. The in-game A/B of #65 (DayZDiag 1.29.163709, 2026-10-02, dayz-mcp run cf2d6bb3; CLAIM-P3D-UNCOVERED-FACES-INGAME) measured that case on whole closed parts: beside box A in Component01, box B in no component of its Geometry, View and Fire LODs took 0 of 46 rays (geom, view, fire, RayCastBullet) and the player walked through it, while as Component02 it took 26 of 26 and stopped the player; the Expert tutorial's closed lever, in no component in Geometry and Fire and a component in View only, took no Geometry, Fire or physics ray and was hit in View only; a part left out only in part was not measured (#65 review round 1, F2). Owner's choices (AskUserQuestion, 2026-10-02): an ERROR only where measured; version 1.10.0, because the 1.9.0 wheel pinned by #60 carries the 1.9.0 check; the change built on #65 and opened after it merged. Implementation: the LOD's faces, proxy triangles aside, are grouped into pieces that share a corner position, read as the MLOD stores it (float32); a piece that is a closed solid (every edge used by two of its faces, once each way, and thicker, twice its volume over its area with the volume summed by math.fsum from the piece's own first corner, than 16 float32 steps at its distance from the origin, at least 1 m) with no face and no point in any component raises ERR_COMPONENT_COVERAGE (ERROR); its message names the measured omissions (all three LODs for the box, Geometry and Fire for the lever) and says that a part left out of one LOD alone, component selections that hold nothing, and weapon fire were not measured. Every other face in no component (a part left out in part, an open piece, a flat double-sided sheet) and the points-only case stay WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE, whose message now says not measured and no longer counts the ERROR's faces. Consumers read before the choice: dayz-model-preflight runner.py turns an ERROR into PREFLIGHT_PY3D_ERROR and a FAIL verdict, dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract audit.py refuses an MLOD with any ERROR other than a deferred ERR_AXIS_SELECTION_MISSING, python -m py3d validate exits 1, and validate() skips its in-memory round trip. Offline: py3d suite 386 passed, 11 skipped (base 334 passed, 11 skipped; the 7 CANON tests were not run, no upstream clone); dayz-model-preflight 74 passed and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract 128 passed (239 subtests) with this py3d on PYTHONPATH (round 0 code). Read-only impact on 414 unique MLODs (the owner's projects on the P: drive and the dayz-doors samples) through P3D._scan_v12_findings with the 1.9.0 and 1.10.0 modules: Expert_Mode's Geometry and Fire LODs move from the WARN to the ERROR (the lever, one closed 18-face piece in no component), a vehicle Fire LOD keeps the WARN, with the new message, for two stray 1 mm triangles, and no other finding changed in any model; with the full validate(), making every coverage finding an ERROR would flip one verdict (Expert_Mode, PASS to FAIL) while 160 of the 414 already fail on other ERRORs. Cross-family review (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, read-only, cap of 2 rounds set before round 1): round 1 UNSOUND on 756daa7, F1 P1 (the volume summed from the model's origin cancelled, so a flat double-sided sheet 1.8 mm across near 62.5 m read as a solid and raised the ERROR), F2 P2 (per-kind message projected a three-LOD and a two-LOD omission onto one LOD), F3 P2 (no test for exactly one covered face, either winding, float32 rounding), F4 P2 (README counted the unrun CANON tests); all four fixed as above, with tests. Round 2 SOUND-WITH-FIXES on 32d1178 (F1, F3, F4 resolved, F2 partial): N1 P2 (the WARN called a closed slab under the cutoff not a closed solid; it now says too thin to count as solid at its distance from the origin), N2 P2 (the ERROR message, and the openings of killer #8 in SKILL.md and killers-detail.md section 8, gave the lever the box's walk-through; each part now has its own readings, the old text quoted in dated notes), N3 P2 (a 32-step cutoff and a 3V/A thickness survived; now pinned by a box-size oracle and slabs 10 % under and over the cutoff), N4 P3 (an exactly flat sheet gives 0 or a residue far below the cutoff, not always 0); fixed after the cap and checked mechanically, no third round. (1) dayz-animation-pipeline scripts/seanim_writer.py dropped SEAnim bone modifiers: read_seanim read the modifier block and discarded it (line 164 at ea7b396) and write_seanim always wrote bone_modifier_count = 0 (line 87). Measured 2026-10-03: the DayZATool 1.3 extract of vanilla p_1hd_erc_idle_low.anm (sha256 b798f6d2e2b6141a..., 370,800 B; 65 bones, ABSOLUTE header, 60 RELATIVE modifiers) read and written back by the ea7b396 script came out 370,680 B with the header modifier count 0. read_seanim now returns each bone's modifier (None when it has none) and raises ValueError on a modifier index out of range or repeated; write_seanim writes one (bone index, type) entry per bone carrying a modifier, in bone order, with the index as wide as the reader expects (one byte up to 255 bones, two up to 65,535), and raises ValueError on a value outside 0..255, a bool or a float, or more than 255 modifiers. The fixed script writes that extract and the four clips spliced from it on 2026-10-02 back byte for byte; bones without a modifier key write the same bytes as before. New tests/test_seanim_writer.py: fixtures built byte by byte from the SEAnim v1 layout (SE2Dev io_anim_seanim seanim.py), not with write_seanim, and read the same way by the Pack's tools/dayz-animation-formats strict reader; 22 cases, all 22 failing against the ea7b396 script and passing with the fix (13 written first; 7 added after review round 1, which found 7 kinds of mutant surviving the 13: modifier 0 dropped on read or on write, the bone-index width off by one at 255 or 65,535 bones, only 0..3 accepted, 255 modifiers refused, False accepted; 2 added after review round 2, which found two more surviving the 20: a repeated index accepted when its type repeats too, and a modifier equal to the header's type dropped on write; 13 mutants of those kinds plus two the 13 already caught each fail at least one of the 22). (3) player-skeleton.md, claim CLAIM-ANIM-IKPOSE-OBJECT-FRAME: the frame an ikpose keys LeftHandIKTarget in (the object's, RightHand_Dummy's), RightHandOrigin's unknown frame, LeftHandOrigin's untested one, and the SEAnim axes of a held object (SEAnim Z up, Y depth, signs not fixed), re-measured offline on five vanilla ikposes and two vanilla LOD0s; the in-game observations are the CocaLab session's of 2026-09-27.
